title: , the notaries
name: Marcian and Martyrius
troparia: (Tone 1) The pair of martyrs equal in rank,* Marcian and the glorious Martyrius crushed the infamy of Arius,* and taught to believe in the Son, consubstantial with Father and the Spirit,* in obedience to Paul the teacher of true commands.* For this they were put to death by the sword* and live forever with Christ,** praying on our behalf that He may save our souls.
kontakia: (Tone 4) You lived piously since your childhood, O Marcian and Martyrius,* and you came to crush Arius.* You preserved the teachings of the faith intact* by following the wise teacher, Paul.* You have found life in his company* as defenders of the Trinity.
